body.zh-Hant: 1876年9月5日生於巴伐利亞的蘭茨貝格。1895年7月進入奧格斯堡的第4野戰砲兵團，1900至1901年隨東亞遠征軍的野戰砲兵團赴中國，任山砲連排長。第一次世界大戰期間，自1915年春起任第11巴伐利亞步兵師的第1總參軍官，1918年多半被排除於重大決策之外，改受命研究戰史。
body.en: Born on 5 September 1876 in Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, he joined the 4th Field Artillery Regiment in Augsburg in July 1895 and in 1900–01 served as a platoon leader with the East Asian field artillery regiment in China. From spring 1915 he was first general staff officer of the 11th Bavarian Infantry Division; in 1918 he was mostly kept away from key decisions and given war-history studies.

heading.zh-Hant: 國防軍時期的參謀與軍區職務

body.zh-Hant: 1919至1921年他在國防部任參謀，1921至1923年任第2軍區（什切青）參謀長，1923至1924年任第7軍區（慕尼黑）參謀長，1924至1928年任第7砲兵團的營長與團長。1930至1933年任慕尼黑的師長，1933至1938年任卡塞爾第2集團司令部司令。1938年2月底，他在布隆貝格—弗里奇危機中被免職。
body.en: In 1919–21 he was a staff officer in the Reichswehr ministry, in 1921–23 chief of staff of Wehrkreis II (Stettin) and in 1923–24 of Wehrkreis VII (Munich), and in 1924–28 battalion and regiment commander of Artillery Regiment 7. He commanded a division in Munich in 1930–33 and Group Command 2 in Kassel in 1933–38. At the end of February 1938 he was dismissed in the Blomberg–Fritsch crisis.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年10月他被重新起用，參與進入蘇台德地區，11月晉升上將。1940年西線攻勢期間他任C集團軍群總司令；據NDB，他的第7集團軍成功渡過上萊茵河，第1集團軍突破馬其諾防線，他隨即下令停止戰鬥以免無謂損失。1940年7月19日他晉升元帥。
body.en: In October 1938 he was reactivated and took part in the march into the Sudetenland, and in November he was promoted Generaloberst. During the 1940 offensive in the west he was commander-in-chief of Army Group C; according to the NDB, after the Seventh Army crossed the Upper Rhine and the First Army broke through the Maginot Line he soon had the fighting stopped to avoid needless losses. On 19 July 1940 he was promoted Generalfeldmarschall.

heading.zh-Hant: 北方集團軍群與列寧格勒

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月22日德軍進攻蘇聯，里布任北方集團軍群司令。他的部隊在波羅的海地區初期有進展，但列寧格勒之圍未能成功，他與希特勒因而失和；據NDB，他逼使自己去職，1942年1月16日轉入陸軍總司令部的元首預備隊，此後未再任職。
body.en: When the attack on the Soviet Union began on 22 June 1941, Leeb commanded Army Group North. After early successes in the Baltic region the siege of Leningrad failed and he fell out with Hitler; according to the NDB he forced his own dismissal and on 16 January 1942 went into the Führer reserve of the army high command, and was not employed again.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月2日，德國投降前不久，他被美軍俘虜。1948年10月27、28日，紐倫堡審判以轉發命令為由判他三年徒刑，10月29日獲釋；LeMO指出該判決基於文件混淆。1954年他任巴伐利亞軍事馬克斯·約瑟夫勳章的大總管，1956年4月29日逝世。
body.en: On 2 May 1945, shortly before the German surrender, he was taken prisoner by the Americans. On 27–28 October 1948 the Nuremberg trial sentenced him to three years for passing on an order, and he was released on 29 October; LeMO notes the verdict rested on a confusion of documents. In 1954 he became grand chancellor of the Bavarian Military Max Joseph Order, and he died on 29 April 1956.

body.zh-Hant: 1848年5月生於梅克倫堡的格索多夫莊園。1869年入第86燧發槍兵團，1870至1871年參加對法戰爭，1875至1878年在柏林戰爭學院受總參軍官訓練。1882年起任其叔父、總參謀長老毛奇的副官，1888年升為首席副官；1891年叔父去世後，成為威廉二世的侍從副官。
body.en: He was born in May 1848 on the Gersdorf estate in Mecklenburg. He joined Fusilier Regiment 86 in 1869, took part in the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–71 and trained as a general staff officer at the Berlin War Academy in 1875–78. From 1882 he was adjutant to his uncle, the elder Moltke, becoming first adjutant in 1888, and after his uncle's death in 1891 he became a wing adjutant of Wilhelm II.

body.zh-Hant: 1893年他升中校，任宮廷衛兵連連長，據NDB此後十一年他都在皇帝身邊；1899年升少將，1902年升中將並任第1近衛步兵師師長，同時成為皇帝的總侍從武官。1904年2月16日，他被任命為軍需總監，成為接替施里芬的人選。
body.en: Promoted lieutenant colonel in 1893, he commanded the Palace Guard Company and, according to the NDB, for eleven years remained in the emperor's immediate circle; he became major general in 1899 and lieutenant general in 1902, commanding the 1st Guards Infantry Division and serving as adjutant general to the emperor. On 16 February 1904 he was appointed Generalquartiermeister, which made him a candidate to succeed Schlieffen.

body.zh-Hant: 1906年1月1日，威廉二世任命他為陸軍總參謀長，接替施里芬。NDB指出，他是主要因與皇帝的友誼而獲選，過去在大總參謀部的工作經驗不多。1912年，應魯登道夫之請，他設法擴充陸軍；1914年1月27日晉升上將。
body.en: On 1 January 1906 Wilhelm II appointed him Chief of the General Staff of the Army, succeeding Schlieffen. The NDB notes that he was chosen chiefly because of his friendship with the emperor and had little experience in the work of the Great General Staff. In 1912, at Ludendorff's urging, he sought to strengthen the army, and on 27 January 1914 he was promoted Generaloberst.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月1日戰爭爆發，他負責指揮德軍的作戰。對法作戰計畫以施里芬的研究為基礎，須穿越中立的比利時；同時代人批評他削弱了右翼。9月9日馬恩河戰役中，他下令撤回艾斯訥河後方。9月14日他把作戰指揮交給法爾肯海因，11月3日法爾肯海因正式接任總參謀長。
body.en: From 1 August 1914 he directed the operations of the German army. The German plan against France, based on Schlieffen's studies, called for an advance through neutral Belgium; contemporaries blamed him for weakening the right wing. On 9 September at the Marne he ordered the retreat behind the Aisne. On 14 September he handed the direction of operations to Falkenhayn, who formally succeeded him on 3 November.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年12月30日他改任柏林留守總參謀部部長，負責確保德國的糧食供應。NDB形容他在馬恩河挫敗後成為一個精神崩潰的人；1916年6月18日他因中風在柏林去世。
body.en: On 30 December 1914 he became chief of the deputy general staff in Berlin, responsible for securing German food supplies. The NDB describes him as a spiritually broken man after the setback on the Marne; he died of a stroke in Berlin on 18 June 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 1890年9月23日生於黑森的布賴特瑙，父親是會計人員。1910年2月入普魯士陸軍任見習軍官，第一次世界大戰期間自1915年起在多個總參部擔任傳令軍官，獲鐵十字勳章，大戰結束時為上尉及總參軍官。
body.en: He was born on 23 September 1890 in Breitenau, Hesse, the son of an accounts clerk. He entered the Prussian army as an officer cadet in February 1910 and from 1915, in the First World War, served as orderly officer in various general staffs; decorated with the Iron Cross, he ended the war as a captain and general staff officer.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年他留在國防軍。1934年他任柏林近郊溫斯多夫的第3汽車化營營長，1935年9月1日任汽車部隊司令部參謀長，該機構負責建立裝甲兵；1939年1月1日升少將，任第16裝甲軍參謀長。
body.en: He stayed on in the Reichswehr in 1920. In 1934 he commanded Motor Vehicle Battalion 3 at Wünsdorf near Berlin, and on 1 September 1935 became chief of staff of the Command of Motorised Troops, the body forming the panzer arm. On 1 January 1939 he became major general and chief of staff of the XVI Panzer Corps.

heading.en: Poland, France and planning against the USSR

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月26日，他任第10集團軍（後改稱第6集團軍）的參謀長，隨該軍參加波蘭、法國與比利時的戰役。自1940年9月3日起他任陸軍總參謀部第一軍需長，是參謀總長哈爾德的副手，參與了「巴巴羅薩」作戰的各階段規劃。
body.en: On 26 September 1939 he became chief of staff of the Tenth Army (later renamed Sixth Army) and took part in the campaigns in Poland, France and Belgium. From 3 September 1940 he was Oberquartiermeister I in the army general staff, deputy to chief of staff Halder, and was involved in every phase of the operational planning for Barbarossa.

heading.zh-Hant: 第6集團軍與史達林格勒

body.zh-Hant: 1942年1月他受命統率第6集團軍，哈爾科夫戰役獲勝後獲騎士鐵十字勳章。6月28日夏季攻勢開始，第6集團軍於8月21日渡過頓河向史達林格勒進攻；11月22日蘇軍反攻使該軍被包圍，曼施坦因的解圍攻勢「冬季風暴」12月19日受阻於梅什科瓦河。
body.en: In January 1942 he was given command of the Sixth Army and, after the victorious Kharkov battle, received the Knight's Cross. The summer offensive began on 28 June, and on 21 August the Sixth Army attacked across the Don toward Stalingrad. The Soviet attack encircled the army on 22 November, and Manstein's relief attempt Wintergewitter stalled at the Myshkova on 19 December.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年1月8日他拒絕蘇軍的投降要求；他請求的投降被希特勒否決，1月30至31日夜間他被晉升元帥，31日入蘇軍戰俘營。1944年8月8日他在蘇方安排下加入德國軍官聯盟，並依LeMO在德意志自由全國委員會的委託下多次發出對國防軍的投降呼籲。1953年獲釋後定居德勒斯登，1957年2月1日在當地去世。
body.en: On 8 January 1943 he rejected a Soviet call to surrender; Hitler refused the capitulation he requested, he was promoted Generalfeldmarschall on the night of 30–31 January, and on 31 January he went into Soviet captivity. On 8 August 1944 he joined the League of German Officers and made several appeals to the Wehrmacht to capitulate on behalf of the National Committee Free Germany, according to LeMO. Released in 1953, he settled in Dresden and died there on 1 February 1957.

body.zh-Hant: 1881年5月30日生於哈瑙附近的菲利普斯魯厄宮，父親是軍官。1901年任砲兵少尉，1914年調入大總參謀部；大戰爆發時他率砲兵連攻佔比利時的迪克斯穆德，其後在西線各軍參謀部任職。1919年他在庫爾蘭旅的自由軍團中戰鬥。
body.en: He was born on 30 May 1881 at Schloss Philippsruhe near Hanau, the son of an officer. He became an artillery lieutenant in 1901 and was posted to the Great General Staff in 1914; at the outbreak of the First World War he led an artillery battery that took the Belgian town of Dixmuide, and he later served in staffs on the Western Front. In 1919 he fought in the Freikorps Brigade Kurland.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年他被併入國防軍，1924至1929年任德勒斯登步兵學校教官。1933年10月1日任柯尼斯堡的第1砲兵指揮官，1935年任軍校督察，1937年4月1日晉升砲兵上將並任駐東普魯士的第1軍軍長；1939年3月23日進入梅梅爾地區的部隊屬其軍。
body.en: In 1920 he was taken into the Reichswehr and from 1924 to 1929 taught at the infantry school in Dresden. On 1 October 1933 he became Artillerieführer I in Königsberg, in 1935 inspector of the war schools, and on 1 April 1937 he was promoted General der Artillerie and made commanding general of I Army Corps in East Prussia; the troops that entered the Memel region on 23 March 1939 belonged to his corps.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月動員時，他受命統率北方集團軍群中的第3集團軍，攻佔格勞登茨並渡過布格河與納雷夫河，包圍華沙。據LeMO，他拒絕調派部隊迫害猶太人與波蘭平民而被撤職，後改調西線的第18集團軍。1940年5月10日該軍攻入荷蘭，6月14日未戰入巴黎；7月19日他升上將。
body.en: At mobilisation in September 1939 he took command of the Third Army in Army Group North, which took Graudenz and crossed the Bug and Narew to encircle Warsaw. According to LeMO he refused to commit troops to the persecution of Jews and Polish civilians and was relieved, but was moved instead to command the Eighteenth Army in the west. On 10 May 1940 that army invaded the Netherlands, on 14 June it entered Paris without a fight, and on 19 July he became Generaloberst.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月22日進攻蘇聯時，第18集團軍編入北方集團軍群。1942年1月他接替里布，掌北方集團軍群並指揮列寧格勒之圍，同年晉升元帥。1944年1月14日蘇軍攻勢使集團軍群遭到重創並退回波羅的海地區；2月1日他被免職，由莫德爾接替。
body.en: When the Soviet Union was attacked on 22 June 1941 the Eighteenth Army was part of Army Group North. In January 1942 he succeeded Leeb in command of the army group and so directed the siege of Leningrad, and was promoted Generalfeldmarschall that year. A Russian attack beginning on 14 January 1944 inflicted a heavy defeat and pushed the army group back into the Baltic; on 1 February he was dismissed and replaced by Model.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月他被美軍逮捕。1948年10月28日，他在紐倫堡的最高統帥部案中被判二十年徒刑，1951年減為十二年，1953年2月18日獲釋。他晚年隱居，拒絕撰寫回憶錄，1968年5月25日在加米施-帕滕基興去世。
body.en: He was arrested by the Americans in May 1945. On 28 October 1948 he was sentenced to twenty years' imprisonment in the Nuremberg High Command case; the sentence was reduced to twelve years in 1951 and he was released on 18 February 1953. He lived in retirement, declined to write memoirs, and died in Garmisch-Partenkirchen on 25 May 1968.

body.zh-Hant: 1875年12月12日生於阿舍斯萊本，父親是少將。1892年中學畢業後入卡塞爾的普魯士步兵第83團，1909年升為總參謀部上尉。第一次世界大戰期間，他以總參軍官身分在土耳其與法國作戰，在規劃與調動部隊上有貢獻。
body.en: He was born on 12 December 1875 in Aschersleben, the son of a major general. After his school-leaving exam he joined Prussian Infantry Regiment 83 in Kassel in 1892 and became a captain on the general staff in 1909. In the First World War he served as a general staff officer in Turkey and France and earned credit for the planning and movement of army formations.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年他被併入國防軍。1932年10月起任柏林第1集團司令部總司令並晉升步兵上將；1938年3月1日在布隆貝格—弗里奇危機中升為大將，10月1日在占領蘇台德地區時統率一個集團軍群。1938年11月他因抗議進軍時機、認為國防軍尚未備戰而被免職。
body.en: In 1919 he was taken into the Reichswehr. From October 1932 he was commander-in-chief of Group Command 1 in Berlin and General der Infanterie; on 1 March 1938, in the Blomberg–Fritsch crisis, he was promoted Generaloberst, and on 1 October during the occupation of the Sudetenland he led an army group. In November 1938 he was retired because he protested the timing of the advance, holding that the Wehrmacht was not yet ready for war.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年夏他被重新起用，9月1日大戰爆發時任南方集團軍群總司令，參與進攻波蘭；NDB補充他在1939年10月短暫任東線總司令。1940年5至6月法國戰役中，他任A集團軍群總司令，統率裝甲部隊穿過阿登直抵海峽沿岸；1940年7月19日晉升元帥。
body.en: He was reactivated in the summer of 1939 and, when the Second World War began on 1 September, took part in the attack on Poland as commander-in-chief of Army Group South; the NDB adds that he briefly served as Oberbefehlshaber Ost in October 1939. In the French campaign of May–June 1940 he commanded Army Group A, leading the armoured thrust through the Ardennes to the Channel coast, and on 19 July 1940 he was promoted Generalfeldmarschall.

body.zh-Hant: 1941年6月22日進攻蘇聯時，他任烏克蘭的南方集團軍群總司令，部隊攻佔克里米亞與頓涅茨盆地，並推進到頓河畔的羅斯托夫。12月3日他違抗希特勒的命令自羅斯托夫撤軍，12月5日被賴歇瑙取代；1942年3月15日他被任命為西線總司令。
body.en: When the Soviet Union was attacked on 22 June 1941 he took the supreme command of Army Group South in Ukraine; under his leadership the Crimea and the Donets basin were taken and his troops reached Rostov on the Don. On 3 December, against Hitler's order, he pulled the army group back from Rostov, and on 5 December he was replaced by Reichenau; on 15 March 1942 he was appointed Oberbefehlshaber West.

heading.en: Commander-in-chief West and the Allied landings

body.zh-Hant: 任西線總司令期間，1942年8月盟軍在迪耶普的登陸行動失敗。據NDB，他未能發展出有效策略對抗盟軍登陸；1944年6月登陸成功後，他於7月被免職，1944年8至9月主持「榮譽法庭」，9月5日奉命返回西線，1945年1月又奉命以阿登攻勢反擊盟軍但告失敗，1945年3月9日退休。
body.en: During his time as commander-in-chief West, an Allied landing at Dieppe failed in August 1942. According to the NDB he failed to devise an effective strategy against the Allied invasion; after it succeeded in June 1944 he was removed in July, chaired the court of honour in August and September 1944, was recalled to the West on 5 September, and in January 1945 was ordered to push the Allies back in the Ardennes offensive, which failed; he was retired on 9 March 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月他在巴特托爾茨被美軍逮捕，移交英國戰俘營，因被控戰爭罪行受審，但因健康不佳而中止，並未被定罪。1949年5月5日他因心臟病獲釋，遷居策勒附近，1953年2月24日去世。
body.en: In May 1945 he was arrested by American troops in Bad Tölz and handed over to British captivity, where he was charged with war crimes; because of his poor health the proceedings were suspended and he was never convicted. On 5 May 1949 he was released because of a heart condition and moved near Celle; he died on 24 February 1953.
